Name: Terranigma Chicken
Author: Mushroomyx
Description:
I really like the Chicken from Terranigma, thus this Mod changes the Appearance of the Chicken to resemble those. Some artistic liberty has been taken, in order to somewhat incorporate the original design into Stardew Valleys's artstyle. The most notable differences are the tail feathers being gone due to sprite size differences between the games, the colors of their beaks, claws and combs being brighter, and having a more uniform outline in terms of color.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Enjoy
[/list]
